overview.description: The PGIM Corporate Bond 10+ Year ETF (PCL) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in investment grade fixed income. The fund seeks to provide total return through an actively managed portfolio of investment grade corporate bonds from around the world, with maturities of 10 years or more. PCL was launched on Jul 29, 2025 and is issued by PGIM.
